mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions, indicated by rising employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE), signal robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime characterized by elevated new housing starts (HOUST) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS), demand for goods and services accelerates, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of housing boom periods defined by HOUST > 800 and RSAFS > 400,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE) indicate weak labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated new housing starts (HOUST) above 800 thousand units signal strong demand for residential construction, which correlates with broader economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 800, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above the 2017 base level (100) indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply chain strength, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) creates a stagflationary environment that erodes corporate margins and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
